test_cases.title: Applicant opens the review timings page and sees the filters
acs: DERIVED: Applicant opens the review timings page and sees the filters - features/review-timings/review-timings.feature:6

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the review timings page
steps.expected: The review timings page is displayed with its heading and controls

steps.action: Check the page that is displayed
steps.expected: The review timings page is displayed

steps.action: Check the review timings page content
steps.expected: The filters are visible

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed
